en.headline: Yan Ting opens two-night Coliseum run with The Alchemist Live
en.dek: Singer Yan Ting begins a two-night stand at Hong Kong Coliseum this evening, with a second show on Saturday, after tickets went on sale through Cityline and URBTIX.
body: Singer Yan Ting is scheduled to open The Alchemist Live 2026 at Hong Kong Coliseum in Hung Hom on Friday evening, with a second performance on Saturday.

Listings for the shows give a start time of 8.15 p.m. and name Bank of China (Hong Kong) as presenter. Tickets were sold through Cityline and the Urban Ticketing System at three price points, according to the published sale notices.
The concerts are among the live dates filling the Coliseum this month. Organisers have not announced any change to the Friday opening at the time of writing.

zh.headline: 周殷廷紅館《The Alchemist Live》今晚揭幕
zh.dek: 歌手周殷廷今晚及周六連續兩場在紅磬香港體育館舉行演唱會，門票較早前經城市售票網及URBTIX發售。
body: 歌手周殷廷今晚起在紅磬香港體育館舉行《The Alchemist Live 2026》演唱會，周六加開一場。
公開售票資料顯示兩場演出定於晚上8時15分開始，由中銀香港呈獻，門票分三個票價，較早前經城市售票網及URBTIX發售。
紅館本月繼續有多場現場演出。截稿前主辦單位未有公布周五場次有改動。
